supplier_excerpt: Let $(X,d)$ be a metric space ([[def-metric-space]]), let $G:X\to X$ be a specified map, and choose an initial point $x_0\in X$, a residual tolerance $\varepsilon\ge0$, and an iteration budget $N\in\mathbb N_0$. For $k=0,1,\ldots,N$, compute $r_k:=d(G(x_k),x_k)$. If $r_k\le\varepsilon$, return residual-tolerance-met; otherwise, if $k=N$, return iteration-budget-exhausted; otherwise set $x_{k+1}:=G(x_k)$ and continue.
